prompt: A ring city around a crater lake, every house facing the water.

card.name: Ring City of the Crater Lake

site.text: A ring city circling a crater lake, with every house facing the water.

style.text: No style given; a calm lakeside look in stone and timber that suits a ring city.

purpose.text: A home settlement for living around the lake, with a ring of homes and shared civic buildings.

card.interpretation: You asked for a ring city around a crater lake. I took the site as a crater with a lake in the middle and the city as a ring of buildings along the rim, all facing inward. Style was not given, so I chose a calm medieval stone-and-timber look. The purpose is a place to live, with a few shared buildings. No backstory was given, so I left it empty.
assumptions: Size L, since a ring city needs room.
Medieval style, since none was given.
Crater and lake are sculpted, since neither is assumed to exist.
Density is medium and the search is not tied to a spot.

program.notes: Ring the crater rim. Fronts, doors and windows face the lake.
Fill gaps in the ring. Doors face the water.
Grand civic hall on the rim, looking out over the lake.
Gates in the ring road, on opposite sides of the rim.
Boats and a pier on the lake shore.
Small stalls on the ring road, facing the water.
Stores food on the outer edge of the ring.
